description.narrative: (Cote d'Ivoire): Linking family planning and HIV services is crucial for achieving Family Planning 2030 goals and for realizing the ambitious global HIV goals. Women of reproductive age are disproportionately affected by the HIV epidemic. The PEPFAR-supported Determined, Resilient, Empowered, AIDS-free, Mentored, and Safe (DREAMS; REVE) is a global public-private partnership implemented in 15 countries with Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, Girl Effect, Gilead Sciences, ViiV Healthcare, and Johnson & Johnson. It provides a comprehensive, multi-sectoral package of core interventions to address key factors that make girls and young women particularly vulnerable to HIV including: educational support, economic strengthening activities (e.g. Village Savings and Loans Associations); caregiver/parenting programming; HIV counseling, testing and referral among others...Many women, especially young women and adolescent girls are simultaneously at risk for both unintended pregnancy and HIV infection. FP funding will be provided to the REVE project to strengthen the provision of FP services within the DREAMS package for the 17,700 adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) aged 15 to 24 years old who are targeted as part of the program in two major areas: Cocody-Bingerville and Daloa. With FY 2022 funding, REVE will strengthen FP demand-creation services, sensitization of FP providers, as well as social media and community-radio programming to reach most at-risk AGYW in DREAMS districts. ..By strengthening FP services for AGYW, this activity supports the ICS 2022 -2025 Mission Objective 3.1: "Côte d'Ivoire improves delivery, accessibility, and quality of basic public health services nationwide.".
